g_a21b63cc8dc8.title: Add ISO 8601 duration formatting to ms

links.evidence: Opening ask "Let's continue with the ISO durations. Parsing is next: parseISO("PT1H30M") should return 5400000, i.e. the inverse of formatISO" continues the formatISO work in the anchor request, and both asks name the same ISO 8601 duration feature in src/index.ts.

anchorAsk.text: I want ISO 8601 duration support in ms, starting with formatting: `formatISO(5400000)` should give "PT1H30M" and `formatISO(90061000)` "P1DT1H1M1S". Days are the largest unit, no months or years since those are ambiguous. Export it from src/index.ts and add tests.

g_2c225448801b.title: Add compound duration string parsing to ms

anchorAsk.text: Separate PR: add `parseCompound` for strings like "1h 30m" or "2 days 4 hours", returning the total in ms, NaN if it can't be parsed. Export it from src/index.ts with tests.
